sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know how to report information and to cite a source with *según* from B1 Unit 13. In history almost every fact comes from a source, so you often name it: *según los arqueólogos…*, *los estudios indican que…*. The verb after *que* is in the indicative.

items.spanish: Según los especialistas, solo se conservan cuatro códices mayas.
items.english: According to the specialists, only four Maya codices survive.

items.spanish: Los arqueólogos dicen que excavan ciudades y tumbas.
items.english: The archaeologists say they excavate cities and tombs.

items.spanish: Los estudios indican que había miles de estructuras bajo el bosque.
items.english: Studies indicate that there were thousands of structures under the forest.

items.spanish: Según un estudio publicado en 2018, la tecnología LiDAR encontró muchas estructuras.
items.english: According to a study published in 2018, LiDAR technology found many structures.

sections.content: *Según* names the source and takes no *que*: *según los especialistas*. With a verb you need *que*: *los especialistas indican que*. Naming the source shows that a claim is not yours, which matters in history, where experts often disagree.
